clips.title: The story
paras: Battle of Hillsbrad is a Forsaken military mission directed by High Executor Darthalia from Tarren Mill. Following the initial strikes on the northern human farms, Horde operatives are sent south to slaughter the fleeing Hillsbrad Peasants seeking refuge in the orchards.

The campaign against the human presence in Hillsbrad Foothills moves with cold deliberation. After Horde forces strike the northern farms, panic sweeps through the settlement. Rather than taking up arms, many laborers flee southward into the orchards and pastures of Hillsbrad Fields, hoping to hide from the advancing undead. High Executor Darthalia views their terror not with mercy, but as a strategic opening to break Hillsbrad's remaining labor force and morale completely.

Under direct orders from Tarren Mill, champions of the Horde hunt down these displaced laborers in the fields. Deprived of protection, the peasants are systematically eliminated to choke off Hillsbrad's food supply and shatter civilian resolve. For Darthalia and the Forsaken, every human felled tightens the grip of death around the surviving township, ensuring that Lordaeron remains firmly in the hands of the Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked. Most excellent.
Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad. The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.
Prove them wrong, friend. Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants. Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have your orders, adventurer. Quit dawdling here in Tarren Mill when there is work to be done elsewhere.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad. The battle goes well.
